annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2078 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards the European Database on Medical Devices (Eudamed)
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2078 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards the European Database on Medical Devices (Eudamed)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing regulation setting detailed rules for Eudamed, the European medical devices database under the Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745. It covers actor registration and access, machine-to-machine exchange, malfunction contingency procedures, IT security and fraud handling. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Eudamed accessible via restricted site, public site and machine-to-machine services
Actors and users must register, with approval by competent authorities or administrators
Malfunction rules suspend submission deadlines and set 12/24/36-hour fallback reporting
Commission may suspend access on IT security incidents or fraud
EMDN nomenclature must be used and is free of charge
